name: X Stats Tracker
tagline: A nightly scorekeeper for your X account, delivered as a morning briefing
description: While you sleep it keeps score on your X presence: follower count, engagement, mentions and tip activity, each drawn as a trend line instead of a lone number. The sunrise briefing spells out what changed since yesterday, so you can see which direction things are actually moving rather than guessing from a single day.
author: Serenejaysew
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
